In this video, we take a detailed look at *Exit-14 of Package-05 (OD-05) of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor (NH-130CD)* in Odisha.
• Package-05 is one of the most challenging, important & scenic sections of the entire Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor.* Located in *Koraput district of Odisha,* this approximately *44 km long section runs from Borigumma to Dasmantpur, between Chainage 249.000 & 293.000 km.*
